name: mirage
text: Most likely cause: the engine restarted twice in the last hour, and on every restart GitHub has no Kalshi list for about 10 minutes. Your app (v1.0.48 and older) then scans all of Kalshi on the phone itself, and that is what lags and crashes it. v1.0.49 fixes exactly that: it waits for the engine instead. Please install v1.0.49 from the release link above and tell me if it still lags or crashes. If it does, send the Diagnostics report right after, and I'll cut the phone's own Kalshi scan out completely. I'm also making the engine keep the last Kalshi list across restarts so there's no gap at all.
